posts.title: Curvature Beziers
posts.description: Improving on a timeless recipe The bezier curve is a staple of CAD and computer graphics. Like Bic pens, the design is decades old and they're everywhere. You'll often find them as the default or only choice in various illustration and animation tools. posts.title: HTML is Dead, Long Live HTML
posts.description: Rethinking DOM from first principles Browsers are in a very weird place. While WebAssembly has succeeded, even on the server, the client still feels largely the same as it did 10 years ago . Enthusiasts will tell you that accessing native web APIs via WASM is a solved problem, with some minimal JS glue . But the question not asked is why you would want to access the DOM. It's just the only option.
